description.value: Four Olives is a casual Mediterranean fusion restaurant in Vancouver's Point Grey neighbourhood, serving Greek-inspired dishes including souvlaki, mezze-style salads, and baked pastas in an upscale-casual setting. The restaurant offers both a lunch menu and a dinner menu with online ordering, and also provides catering services. Located on West 10th Avenue, it sits along a well-used cycling corridor connecting the UBC endowment lands to central Vancouver.
